subject: Re: Status: Basalt feature audit + licensing risk
body:
Csilla, all — decisions from the Basalt sync.

We go to launch review (Apr 29 slot) with a tiered scope: v1 exposes the twelve datasets Kofi has cleared unconditionally; the research-only sources ship behind an internal-use flag with the license text surfaced in the loader; WildDash stays out entirely.

Quentin's MSeg mapping QA gets one more week — the universal-taxonomy channel is our headline feature and I don't want mapping bugs in the demo. Umar, the integration prototype targets the cleared twelve only; Rosa, cut the packaging long-tail per the priority list.

One admin note: keep tagging everything Project Basalt in docs and the tracker — a couple of untagged threads went missing last week.

Nice work getting the audit done early.

Dmitri
